implemented: Training manifest binds ordered feature names and feature implementation source, labeled training rows, model code, parameters, seed, and serialized model artifact.
Model identity changes when its training rows, feature implementation/schema, training code, configuration, seed, or model artifact changes.
Model loading rejects artifact tampering and legacy manifests without required lineage fields.
Prediction batches are content-addressed by as-of date, model identity, lineage, and exact score values.
Daily score cache verifies batch content and current model artifact before returning cached rows.
